DestinationConfig.description_en: The configuration information of the asynchronous invocation destination
DestinationConfig.description_zh: 异步调用目标的配置信息
DestinationConfig.title: 异步调用目标配置

description_en: Queries all asynchronous invocation configurations of a function in a service. If the number of configurations exceeds the value of the limit parameter, the nextToken parameter is returned. You can use the nextToken parameter to query the next page of results
description_zh: 查询一个服务下某个函数的所有异步配置。当配置个数超过limit个数时，将返回nexttoken参数。可以使用该参数进行后续的分页查询
kebab_example: aliyun fc-open list-function-async-invoke-configs --service-name demo-service --function-name helloworld --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFunctionAsyncInvokeConfigs

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of resources to return. Default value: 20. The value cannot exceed 100. The number of returned configurations is less than or equal to the specified number
parameters.help_zh: 最多返回个数。 如果不设定，默认返回20，最大不能超过100。返回结果可以小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The token required to obtain more results. If the number of resources exceeds the limit, the nextToken parameter is returned. You can include the parameter in subsequent calls to obtain more results. You do not need to provide this parameter in the first call
parameters.help_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，后续查询的Token从返回结果中获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: x_fc_account_id

parameters.help_en: The CRC-64 value of the function code package. This value is used to check data integrity. The value is automatically calculated by the tool
parameters.help_zh: 函数代码包的CRC-64值，用于校验完整性。应当由工具自动计算
parameters.name: x_fc_code_checksum

parameters.help_en:
The method used to return logs. Valid values:

Tail: returns the last 4 KB of logs that are generated for the current request.
None: No logs are returned for the current request. Default value: None
parameters.help_zh:
请求返回日志。

Tail：返回当前请求产生的最后4 KB日志。
None：默认值，不返回请求日志
parameters.name: x_fc_log_type

parameters.help_en:
The invocation method.

Sync: synchronous
Async: asynchronous
parameters.help_zh:
调用方式。

Sync：同步调用。
Async：异步调用
parameters.name: x_fc_invocation_type

parameters.help_en: The time when the Function Compute is called. The format is EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.help_zh: 函数计算调用时间，格式为EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.name: x_fc_date

parameters.help_en: The trace ID of the invocation request of Function Compute
parameters.help_zh: 函数计算调用请求的调用链ID
parameters.name: x_fc_trace_id

schema.description_zh: 查询异步配置结果结构体

configs.description_en: The list of asynchronous invocation configurations

createdTime.description_en: The time when the asynchronous invocation configuration was created

destinationConfig.description_en: The configuration struct of the destination for asynchronous invocations. If you did not configure this parameter, this parameter is null
destinationConfig.description_zh: 异步调用目标的配置结构体。如果您未进行配置，则该项为空值（Null）

lastModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the configuration was last modified

maxAsyncEventAgeInSeconds.description_en: The maximum validity period of a message. If you have not configured this parameter, this parameter is null
maxAsyncEventAgeInSeconds.description_zh: 消息最大存活时长。如果您未进行配置，则该项为空值（Null）

maxAsyncRetryAttempts.description_en: The maximum number of retries allowed after an asynchronous invocation fails. If you have not configured this parameter, this parameter is null
maxAsyncRetryAttempts.description_zh: 异步调用失败后的最大重试次数。如果您未进行配置，则该项为空值（Null）
maxAsyncRetryAttempts.title_en: 异步调用失败后的最大重试次数
maxAsyncRetryAttempts.title_zh: 异步调用失败后的最大重试次数

qualifier.description_en: The version or alias of the service

statefulInvocation.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the asynchronous task feature. Valid values:

true
false

If you have not configured this parameter, this parameter is null
statefulInvocation.description_zh:
是否开启异步任务。

true：表示已开启异步任务。
false：表示未开启异步任务。  

如果您未进行配置，则该项为空值（Null）

nextToken.description_en: The token used to obtain more results
